summary: Iteration 13 — Kanda POS Customer SMS (Twilio) feature verified end-to-end. 7/7 backend pytest cases green in test_sms.py: 401 without auth on /sms/send, 200 with Manager on /sms/send (echoes {id,to,ok,error}), 400 empty broadcast, 400 >200 recipient cap, happy-path broadcast to a real demo customer with {name} placeholder replaced in the persisted sms_log body, GET /sms/history tenant-scoped + newest-first with all required keys (id,to,body,status,sent_by,sent_at,tenant_id,customer_id), and 401 on unauthenticated history. Frontend verified via playwright: (POS) /login PIN 1234 works, /customers shows [data-testid=sms-customer-{id}] on 25 customer cards, SmsComposer opens on click, template pills populate [data-testid=sms-body], preview updates live, [data-testid=sms-send] delivers and closes the modal. (Dashboard) /biz/login owner@demo.com works, 'Customer SMS' nav link routes to /biz/sms, recipient list renders 25 checkboxes, search filters (0 for bogus query), sms-select-all toggles between select-visible/clear (0↔25), sms-extra-phones increments the counter, sms-broadcast-send is disabled with empty body and enabled with 1+ recipient AND non-empty body, sending resets state and the Recent SMS panel refreshes (new 'iter13 test message' row visible with status=sent).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/sms.py::_log_and_send inserts the sms_log row before calling Twilio and then does a second update_one to flip status. If Twilio takes long and the caller times out, the row stays 'queued' forever with no retry/reconciliation. Consider a background sweeper or store the Twilio SID for later status polling.

Broadcast loop is sequential (`for t in targets: await _log_and_send`). For 200 recipients this could take many seconds and block the request. Consider asyncio.gather with a small concurrency semaphore (e.g. 10) to speed up bulk sends.

customer_ids query uses {'$in': payload.customer_ids} with limit .to_list(500) but the endpoint is capped at 200 — fine, but if a caller passes 500 IDs only 500 fetched then rejected as >200; message would be clearer if the check ran on len(payload.customer_ids) before the DB round-trip.
DashSms.jsx: after send, `setBody('Hi {name}, ')` hard-codes English; consider preserving prior template selection or clearing entirely for i18n readiness.
SmsComposer preview only shows first 80 chars — no way to see the fully personalised long body before sending; consider expanding or making it scrollable.
